apps.name: Immersive Reader for Safari
apps.description: We brought Immersive Reader to Safari! Transform any web page into an accessible reading experience with text-to-speech, adjustable fonts, focus modes, and translation tools.

apps.name: ProcrastiNOT
apps.description: Say goodbye to procrastination and hello to productivity with ProcrastiNOT! This extension is your personal productivity guardian, helping you stay focused and accomplish more, by blocking websites when you're trying to get work done!

apps.name: Hide Spoilers
apps.description: Blur & Block spoilers on any website with Hide Spoilers. This extension will help you avoid spoilers for your favorite shows, movies, and games.

apps.name: Confetti Cannon
apps.description: Add a burst of joy to any webpage with a single click, turning your screen into a fun confetti celebration whenever you need it!

apps.name: Markdown Editor
apps.description: A simple, beautiful markdown editor with live preview, auto-save, and document management. Now a standalone app for Mac and iPad.

apps.name: Incognito Bear
apps.description: Just one click, Incognito Bear removes all NSFW contents or a list of your own from your browsing history, so you can enjoy worry-free browsing.

apps.name: Simple Screenshot Pro
apps.description: This tool brings ease and precision to capturing entire webpages or just the visible parts.

tools.name: Drop Dungeon
tools.description: A roguelike twist on Connect Four. Clear seven mutating floors, grab a relic after each win, and outdrop the dungeon, solo against an escalating AI, or duel a friend online with an invite link.

tools.name: Vibe Check
tools.description: A daily mood puzzle game. A quick, low-pressure game to play with your morning coffee.

tools.name: Word Clock
tools.description: A clock that tells the time in words instead of numbers. Calm, readable, and oddly satisfying to watch.

tools.name: Flip a Coin
tools.description: An instant decision maker. Flip a coin when you just need something to pick for you.

tools.name: MP3 to Transcript
tools.description: Turn an audio file into a text transcript in your browser. Handy for podcasts, interviews and voice notes.

tools.name: Focus Timer
tools.description: A clean, ADHD-friendly Pomodoro timer. Tiny sprint presets, one task at a time, visible progress, and the exact clock time you'll finish. Free, no signup, colorblind-safe.

tools.name: Private Line: Encrypted Chat
tools.description: A private, end-to-end encrypted chat for two, straight from your browser. Ephemeral keys and AES-256-GCM encryption run on your device; the server never sees your messages. Verify a safety phrase, say your piece, and close the tab, nothing is kept.

tools.name: Hit or Stand?: Blackjack Trainer
tools.description: Learn perfect blackjack one decision at a time. The dealer shows a card, you make the call, and the book grades you on the spot, with plain-English reasons, the full strategy chart, dealer bust odds, and your personal accuracy stats. No bets, no signup.

tools.name: Silicon Dreams: A Text Adventure
tools.description: A 15-20 minute retro text adventure RPG about the founders of Apple, Microsoft, and Google. Live through real Silicon Valley history from 1971 to 2025, your choices decide which legend you become, or whether you become the teacher who inspired them all.

tools.name: Minecraft Pixel Art Generator
tools.description: Convert any image into Minecraft pixel art. Upload a photo, choose your grid size, and get a block-by-block building guide with a complete shopping list of every block needed.

tools.name: Email Signature Generator
tools.description: Create professional HTML email signatures with photos, social icons, and multiple templates. Free, easy-to-use online tool. Copy and paste into Gmail, Outlook, and more.

tools.name: Chrome Extension Icon Resizer
tools.description: Generate all required icon sizes for your Chrome extension from a single 1024x1024 image. Free, fast, and browser-based. Export 16px to 1024px icons instantly.

tools.name: Hide Text in Images
tools.description: Hide secret messages in images using steganography. Encode and decode hidden text in photos. Privacy-focused, works locally in your browser.

tools.name: Meta Tags Generator
tools.description: Create and preview meta tags for your website. See how your page will look on Google, Facebook, and Twitter before publishing.

tools.name: Text Case Converter
tools.description: Quickly change your text to uppercase, lowercase, title case or any other format. A simple tool that works in your browser with no signup required.

tools.name: Time Zone Converter
tools.description: Simple time zone converter to find out what time it is anywhere in the world.

tools.name: Free Receipt Generator
tools.description: Create professional replacement receipts for bookkeeping. Generate customized receipts with tax calculations, business branding, and instant PDF download.

tools.name: Image Metadata Viewer & Editor
tools.description: View, analyze, and remove EXIF metadata from images. Privacy-focused image metadata editor with instant processing and download.

tools.name: 🔍 Emoji Search & Copy
tools.description: Find and copy any emoji in seconds. Search by name, category, or even skin tone. Perfect for adding a touch of fun to your messages, social media posts, or anywhere you want to express yourself with emojis.

tools.name: Tactical Tiles
tools.description: Challenge your friends to a fun, animated Tic-Tac-Toe game with emojis and real-time multiplayer. No account needed. Includes Power Ups!!

tools.name: Netflix Hidden Categories
tools.description: Browse Netflix's 1,900+ hidden categories and secret genre codes. Search by mood or genre and jump straight into the aisles Netflix never shows you.

tools.name: Color Contrast Checker
tools.description: Check text, link and background colors against WCAG AA and AAA in real time, with live samples at every text size, quick fixes for failing colors, and a palette contrast matrix.

tools.name: Dyslexia Font Tester
tools.description: Compare OpenDyslexic, Lexend, Atkinson Hyperlegible and a standard sans on your own text, with live letter spacing, word spacing, line height and line length, plus a one click WCAG text spacing preset.

opensource.name: Google Profanity Words
opensource.description: Full list of bad words and top swear words banned by Google.

opensource.name: Remove PII
opensource.description: Designed to help with privacy by removing personally identifiable information (PII) from text.

opensource.name: Maths Captcha
opensource.description: Maths-Captcha is a simple Node.js module that generates random math questions and verifies user answers.

graveyard.name: Instant Incognito
graveyard.description: Instant Incognito automatically opens specific websites in incognito mode for enhanced privacy.

graveyard.name: Coco's Trivia Corner
graveyard.description: Coco's Trivia Corner offers over 53,000 unique and random questions to keep you entertained. Perfect for quizzes, game nights, or just challenging yourself!

graveyard.name: Daily Bible Verse+
graveyard.description: Start your day with a dose of hope. BibleVerse brings you a thoughtfully chosen Bible verse every day, wrapped in beautiful themes and spoken aloud in a voice you choose, all with accessibility and peace in mind.

graveyard.name: Remove Video EXIF Data
graveyard.description: View, analyze, and remove metadata from video files. Privacy-focused video metadata editor with instant processing and download.

graveyard.name: Yeti
graveyard.description: Customize your browsing by removing unwanted AI search results on Google™ and applying your own custom CSS to any webpage.

graveyard.name: Should You Test in Production?
graveyard.description: Should You Test in Production? A lighthearted nod to every developer's worst (or best) idea, this site redirects to the iconic Bill O'Reilly clip: 'F*** it, we'll do it live!' Because sometimes, that's just how it feels. 😂

graveyard.name: Forgotten Membership Cards
graveyard.description: Ever been at the checkout and realized you forgot your membership card? Quickly access discounts and rewards at popular stores, even when you’ve left your card at home. Just pull up our site, scan, and save, no need to miss out on deals. Plus, find links to sign up for your own account if you’d like to earn rewards personally. Perfect for those “Oh no!” moments at the counter!

graveyard.name: Mystery Rank
graveyard.description: Join Mystery Rank to secure your spot and climb the ranks in various categories. The more you contribute, the higher you rank, but the twist is, you’ll never know what others paid. Embrace the excitement of mystery and competition!

graveyard.name: Instant Flash Cards
graveyard.description: Turn any site into study vibes with one click. Instant Flash Cards is your hack to making learning stick.

graveyard.name: Auto Pause
graveyard.description: Ever find yourself dozing off while a video keeps playing? Or need a break but forget to pause the music? AutoPause has you covered. Set a timer, and let AutoPause handle stopping your browser's media

graveyard.name: What Coffee should I have?
graveyard.description: Not sure what coffee to have in the morning? Let us pick for you with over 35 different coffees and growing.

graveyard.name: Reddit: Random subreddit button
graveyard.description: Reddits new redesign removed the random button. I wanted it back. So here it is as a chrome extension.

graveyard.name: Clean my history
graveyard.description: Sometimes you forget to delete your history after viewing NSFW sites. Clean my History is a privacy focused Chrome extension that removes over 15,000 NSFW websites and terms from your history in one click.
